title: lathyrus jepsonii subsp. californicus
intro: Lathyrus jepsonii subsp. californicus, commonly known as Jepson's pea or California pea vetch, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Baja California. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus jepsonii subsp. californicus include sedative and anticonvulsant effects, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are found in the plant's leaves, stems, and seeds.
